<?php
// Smoke-test stand-in for Planning Center, only on requests carrying ?pco_mock=1
// so the rest of the suite still checks the no-credentials notices.
if ( empty( $_GET['pco_mock'] ) ) { return; }

add_filter( 'pre_option_ccpco_app_id', fn() => 'smoke' );
add_filter( 'pre_option_ccpco_secret', fn() => 'smoke' );

add_filter( 'pre_http_request', function ( $pre, $args, $url ) {
	if ( strpos( $url, 'https://api.planningcenteronline.com/registrations/v2/' ) !== 0 ) { return $pre; }
	$path   = (string) parse_url( $url, PHP_URL_PATH );
	$signup = [
		'type'       => 'Signup',
		'id'         => '777',
		'attributes' => [
			'name'                 => 'Church Workday',
			'description'          => 'Help spruce up the building.',
			'closed'               => false,
			'logo_url'             => null,
			// PCO's real field: the Church Center form, which sends a signed-out visitor to a login page.
			'new_registration_url' => 'https://smoke.churchcenter.com/registrations/events/777/reservations/new',
		],
		'relationships' => [],
	];
	if ( preg_match( '#/signups/777$#', $path ) ) {
		$body = [ 'data' => $signup, 'included' => [] ];
	} elseif ( preg_match( '#/signups$#', $path ) ) {
		$body = [ 'data' => [ $signup ], 'included' => [], 'meta' => [ 'total_count' => 1 ] ];
	} else {
		$body = [ 'data' => [], 'meta' => [ 'total_count' => 0 ] ];
	}
	return [
		'headers'  => [],
		'body'     => wp_json_encode( $body ),
		'response' => [ 'code' => 200, 'message' => 'OK' ],
		'cookies'  => [],
		'filename' => null,
	];
}, 10, 3 );
